values.value: Remove field access for sensitive fields, or mute them in the permission set group used by the agent. Where the agent must use a sensitive field, mask it (for example with Einstein Trust Layer data masking) and record the decision in the DPIA.
The agent can't read special-category or financial fields it doesn't need, and any sensitive field it does use is masked or explicitly approved in the DPIA.

Are special-category and other sensitive fields excluded from the agent's scope (field-level security, or a muting permission set inside a permission set group), or masked before data reaches the model?
